fields.Name: T040 - Members Form Section and Toolbar Controls
fields.Description: Opens a Members full record form once, then walks its section/toolbar controls (section search-filter, expand/collapse all, width toggle, section-manager drawer, individual section collapse), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T088, T089, T090, T091, T093.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Members', click the exact match), click a member row, then click 'Open Full Record' to load the full form. This shared setup is done ONCE. Then exercise these form controls IN ORDER, and as you finish each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) section-search — in the toolbar 'Search sections...' input, type a term matching a visible section heading and confirm the sections narrow to matches, then type gibberish (e.g. 'zzzqqq') and confirm a 'No sections found' empty state with a 'Clear search' action; (2) expand-collapse-all — click the toolbar 'Collapse all sections' button (chevrons up) and confirm sections collapse to headers, then click 'Expand all sections' (chevrons down) and confirm the bodies re-open; (3) width-toggle — click the width-toggle icon button (tooltip 'Expand to full width' / 'Center content') and confirm the form content layout width visibly changes; (4) section-manager — click the 'Manage section order' icon button (bars-staggered) and confirm the 'Manage Sections' drawer opens listing sections with up/down arrows and a 'Reset to Default Order' option; (5) section-collapse-toggle — click a single section's header (or its chevron) and confirm ONLY that section collapses, then click it again and confirm it re-expands. Keep going until every control has been exercised. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: section-search
checkpoints.instruction: section search-filter narrows and shows no-match empty state
visualCriteria: Typing a matching term in the form's 'Search sections...' box narrows the visible sections to matches, and typing a non-matching term shows a 'No sections found' empty state with a Clear search option

checkpoints.name: expand-collapse-all
visualCriteria: Clicking 'Collapse all sections' collapses the form's section panels to their headers, and clicking 'Expand all sections' re-expands the section bodies

checkpoints.name: width-toggle
checkpoints.instruction: form width toggle changes content width
visualCriteria: Clicking the width-toggle button (Expand to full width / Center content) visibly changes the form content layout width — the panels widen to full-width or re-center

checkpoints.name: section-manager
checkpoints.instruction: Manage Sections drawer opens with reorder controls
visualCriteria: Clicking the 'Manage section order' toolbar button opens a 'Manage Sections' drawer listing the form's sections with up/down move buttons and a 'Reset to Default Order' option

checkpoints.name: section-collapse-toggle
checkpoints.instruction: single section header toggles just that section
visualCriteria: Clicking a single section's header collapses just that section's body (chevron flips), and clicking it again re-expands only that section
